name: The Earthen Ring
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
The recent events with the cult have delayed my plans to travel to Azeroth and I must remain here in Valanaar for a time. You and a handful of other Windshapers will be our vanguard instead. Alaana Stormwalker will be waiting to receive you upon your arrival in Mulgore, and I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we finish our business here. We will join you soon.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there. Banu-Alah, adventurer.
narrative.objectives: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Mulgore and speak with Alana Stormwalker when you arrive.
narrative.offerRewardText: More adventurers from Zephras, I see. Wonderful. The winds surely favor us! It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore this new land.Azeroth is an exciting new world, but it's also a dangerous world. You'd do well to prepare yourself for this new adventure by familiarizing yourself with the lands nearby.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 12 to 13, 3,295 XP in all.

quests.name: Confront Lorthuna
quests.objectiveText: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with the High Priestess Lorthuna.

quests.name: The Fate of Zephras
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

quests.name: What Comes Next
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Ayessa Dawnsinger when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.

quests.name: The Earthen Ring
quests.objectiveText: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Mulgore and speak with Alana Stormwalker when you arrive.

quests.name: Welcome to Azeroth
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Orgrimmar and speak with Thrall in the Valley of Wisdom.

quests.name: Exploring the Horde
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Nazgrel in Grommash Hold to receive further instructions.
